$comment: Golden questions for the text-to-SQL evaluation suite. reference_sql is executed through the same validator and views as generated SQL, so references can only use the analytics surface. compare: scalar | set | ordered | last_numeric | structure. alternatives lists other defensible readings of an ambiguous question. mock:true cases are the deterministic subset the mock provider can answer. adversarial cases have no reference; they pass when the request is rejected or the answer breaks none of the rules. See docs/evaluation.md.

cases.question: How many active vehicles do we have?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_vehicle_count FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'active'

cases.question: How many vehicles are there in each status?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles GROUP BY status

cases.question: Show the number of vehicles by fuel type.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT fuel_type, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles GROUP BY fuel_type

cases.question: How many vehicles does each manufacturer have?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles GROUP BY manufacturer

cases.question: Which five cities have the most vehicles?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles GROUP BY city ORDER BY vehicle_count DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many vehicles were purchased in 2024?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicles_purchased FROM vehicles WHERE purchase_date >= '2024-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: How many vehicles are currently in maintenance status?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'maintenance'

cases.question: List the registration numbers of retired vehicles, 20 at most.
How many electric vehicles are active?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS electric_active FROM vehicles WHERE fuel_type = 'electric' AND status = 'active'

cases.question: How many distinct vehicle types are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_type) AS vehicle_types FROM vehicles

cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

cases.question: How many active customers are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customers WHERE status = 'active'

cases.question: Number of customers per country.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country

cases.question: Which state has the most customers?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many customers joined in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What is the total distance driven on completed trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(distance_km) AS total_distance_km FROM trips WHERE trip_status = 'completed'

cases.question: How many trips were cancelled?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_trips FROM trips WHERE trip_status = 'cancelled'

cases.question: Which 10 vehicles made the most trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trips GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Which vehicles had the highest idle time?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT v.registration_number, AVG(t.idle_time_minutes) AS average_idle_minutes FROM vehicles v JOIN trips t ON t.vehicle_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.registration_number ORDER BY average_idle_minutes DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: What is the total idle time in minutes across all trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(idle_time_minutes) AS total_idle_minutes FROM trips

cases.question: What is the average idle time per trip for each vehicle type?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_type, AVG(t.idle_time_minutes) AS average_idle_minutes FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = t.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.vehicle_type

cases.question: How many trips started in March 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips_started FROM trips WHERE start_time >= '2025-03-01' AND start_time < '2025-04-01'

cases.question: How many liters of fuel did all trips consume?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fuel_consumed_liters) AS total_fuel_liters FROM trips

cases.question: What is the longest single trip distance?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS longest_trip_km FROM trips

cases.question: Which drivers have completed the most trips?
What is the average completed trip distance?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(distance_km) AS average_distance_km FROM trips WHERE trip_status = 'completed'

cases.question: Show fuel consumption by vehicle.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT v.registration_number, SUM(f.liters) AS total_liters, SUM(f.total_cost) AS total_fuel_cost FROM vehicles v JOIN fuel_records f ON f.vehicle_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.registration_number ORDER BY total_liters DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: What is the total fuel cost?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_fuel_cost FROM fuel_records

cases.question: What is the average price per liter of fuel?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(price_per_liter) AS average_price_per_liter FROM fuel_records

cases.question: How many liters of fuel were purchased in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(liters) AS total_liters FROM fuel_records WHERE fuel_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fuel_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Which vehicle type uses the most fuel?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_type, SUM(f.liters) AS total_liters FROM fuel_records f JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = f.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.vehicle_type ORDER BY total_liters DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show the monthly fuel cost for 2025.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', fuel_date) AS fuel_month, SUM(total_cost) AS monthly_fuel_cost FROM fuel_records WHERE fuel_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fuel_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY fuel_month ORDER BY fuel_month

cases.question: What is the total maintenance cost?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_maintenance_cost FROM maintenance_records

cases.question: How many maintenance records are scheduled?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled_records FROM maintenance_records WHERE status = 'scheduled'

cases.question: Total maintenance cost by maintenance type.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT maintenance_type, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY maintenance_type

cases.question: Which 5 vehicles have the highest total maintenance cost?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many maintenance events were completed in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_events FROM maintenance_records WHERE status = 'completed' AND maintenance_date >= '2025-01-01' AND maintenance_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What is the average maintenance cost per vehicle?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_cost_per_vehicle FROM (SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY vehicle_id) per_vehicle
alternatives: SELECT AVG(cost) AS average_cost FROM maintenance_records

cases.question: What is our total revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

cases.question: What were the top 10 customers by revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(i.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE i.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.company_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Show monthly revenue for the last 12 months.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) AS revenue_month, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND invoice_date >= (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) - INTERVAL '12 months' FROM invoices) GROUP BY revenue_month ORDER BY revenue_month

cases.question: How many invoices are overdue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_invoices FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

cases.question: What is the total amount of pending invoices?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS pending_amount FROM invoices WHERE status = 'pending'

cases.question: How much revenue came from each country?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country

cases.question: What is the average invoice amount?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_invoice FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
alternatives: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_invoice FROM invoices

cases.question: How much have customers paid us in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_paid FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid'

cases.question: How many payments failed?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_payments FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed'

cases.question: How many payments were made with each payment method?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method

cases.question: Which customers have overdue invoices?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue'

cases.question: How much tax was invoiced in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(tax_amount) AS total_tax FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-01-01'
alternatives: SELECT SUM(tax_amount) AS total_tax FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many active subscriptions are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_subscriptions FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

cases.question: What is the monthly recurring revenue from active subscriptions?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) AS monthly_recurring_revenue FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

cases.question: How many subscriptions are on each plan?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT plan_name, COUNT(*) AS subscription_count FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan_name

cases.question: What is the average recorded vehicle speed?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(speed_kmph) AS average_speed FROM vehicle_locations

cases.question: What is the highest recorded speed?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(speed_kmph) AS max_speed FROM vehicle_locations

cases.question: How many users do we have in each role?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY role
